ish: reduce hostcmd size to fit within HECI We only want to send single HECI packets as a response to the AP. 120 bytes should be enough for all commands. The EC_CMD_CONSOLE_READ Host command was consistently using 2 HECI packets and this seems to cause issues in the kernel driver. Also setting a guard variable in a more protected way BRANCH=none BUG=b:129937881 TEST=Lock up is much less frequent but not completely gone. arc: networkd: Clean up child process on daemon exit. The child process (ip-helper) does not exit as expected when the parent process is terminated. Left in a useless state, it continually spams the logs with read failures. This patch explicitly stops watching the control socket before quitting which allows the process to terminate. BUG=chromium:921550 BUG=chromium:934644 TEST=flashed nocturne, manually verified log spam is now gone when service goes down. TEST=various tast and autotest presubmit tests Change-Id: I058deacdfa32d2a35324e2c09331e3ae69a07d71 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1558835 Commit-Ready: Garrick Evans <garrick@chromium.org> Tested-by: Garrick Evans <garrick@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hugo Benichi <hugobenichi@google.com> Reviewed-by: Abhishek Bhardwaj <abhishekbh@chromium.org>

FROMLIST: ASoC: rt5677: fall back to DT prop names on error The rt5677 driver uses ACPI-style property names to read from the device API. However, these do not match the property names in _DSD used on the Chromebook Pixel 2015, which are closer to the Device Tree style. Unify the two functions for reading from the device API so that they try ACPI-style names first and fall back to the DT names on error. With this patch, plugging and unplugging the headphone jack switches between headphones and speakers automatically. Signed-off-by: Fletcher Woodruff <fletcherw@chromium.org> (am from https://patchwork.kernel.org/patch/10887831/) BUG=b:121045120, b:121046575 TEST=Plug in headphone/headset and verify that audio switches correctly. Change-Id: Ifa8b0be40c6cd8e94a2ed824090403fd8a58d386 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1559934 Commit-Ready: Fletcher Woodruff <fletcherw@chromium.org> Tested-by: Fletcher Woodruff <fletcherw@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Ross Zwisler <zwisler@chromium.org>
